name: Telefon-Screening
tests: Do you fit on paper? Available? Rate or salary? Language?
questions: Warum suchen Sie eine neue Stelle?
Was ist Ihr Stundensatz / Ihre Lohnvorstellung?
frame: 60-second intro → 1 sentence why this job → clear numbers (rate, start date, workload %)
ready: Intro in 60 s without notes. Rate and start date said at once, no hesitation.

name: Erstgespräch / HR
tests: Motivation, communication, culture fit, rough technical level
questions: Was sind Ihre Stärken und Schwächen?
Wo sehen Sie sich in 3 Jahren?
frame: Who I am → what I built (1 project, 1 number) → why this job → 2 smart questions back
ready: 2-min intro, answers for 8 classic HR questions, 3 questions prepared for every company.

name: Projekt-Deep-Dive
tests: Did YOU build it? Do you understand every decision? Senior depth?
questions: Erzählen Sie von Ihrem letzten Projekt.
Warum Iceberg und nicht Delta Lake?
Was würden Sie heute anders machen?
frame: Context → architecture → my part ('ich') → 1 decision + why → result in numbers → what I'd change
ready: 15 min of 'why?' on MATCH and DigiSanté without stopping. Architecture drawn from memory.

name: Technisches Fachgespräch
tests: Real knowledge of your stack: Java, Spring, SQL, Kafka, K8s, Angular, Azure …
questions: Was ist der Unterschied zwischen HashMap und ConcurrentHashMap?
frame: 30 s answer (what it is, why, where I used it) → offer more → 90 s on request → 3 min with trade-offs
ready: Every tier-1 topic: 30 s answer without notes, plus 2 follow-ups.

name: Live-Coding
tests: Can you code without AI? Do you think aloud? Tests? Edge cases?
questions: Parse diese CSV-Datei und summiere pro Kunde.
Finde das längste Teilstück ohne Wiederholung.
frame: Repeat task → ask about input → simple solution first → better solution → code → test → say the complexity
ready: Easy in 15 min, medium in 30 min, in Java and Python, AI off, speaking all the time.

name: SQL / Datenbank
tests: SQL by hand, indexes, transactions, PostgreSQL knowledge
frame: Say the result shape first → write the query → explain the index → say what can go wrong
ready: 25 of 30 query patterns correct on paper. EXPLAIN output explained.

name: Code-Review / Bugfix
tests: Find bugs, security holes, bad design. Name the pattern and the architecture style.
questions: Was ist falsch an diesem Code?
frame: Correct? → secure? → fast? → readable? → design: name the pattern and architecture
ready: Finds the security bug every time. Names layered / onion / hexagonal / clean correctly.

name: System Design
tests: Structure, trade-offs, data model, SQL said aloud, scaling, failures, security
questions: Entwerfen Sie Bild-Upload mit Bilderkennung und Suche.
frame: Questions first (users, size) → API → data model + SQL → flow → storage and search → scaling → failures → security → cost
ready: 8 classic designs, each 40 min on paper, with tables and 2 SQL queries said aloud.

name: Data-Engineering-Design
tests: Pipelines, lakehouse, modelling, idempotency, late data, Spark tuning
questions: Bauen Sie eine Pipeline für Banktransaktionen.
Was passiert, wenn der Job zweimal läuft?
Wie modellieren Sie das (Star Schema, SCD2)?
frame: Sources → ingest → bronze/silver/gold → model → quality → orchestration → serving → cost
ready: MATCH explained as a design. 2 new pipelines designed. Idempotency and partitioning defended.

name: Architektur-Review
tests: Find flaws in a diagram, stay calm under many questions, propose fixes with trade-offs
questions: Was ist falsch an dieser Architektur?
Was passiert, wenn dieser Service ausfällt?
frame: Check in order: availability → security → data consistency → coupling → scaling → monitoring → cost
ready: 5 flaws in 10 min, each with a fix and a trade-off. Calm when interrupted.

name: Take-Home + Präsentation
tests: Clean code, tests, README, Docker. Can you defend every line?
frame: README: run it → decisions → trade-offs → what's next. Then defend.
ready: 1 Spring Boot service and 1 PySpark ETL built by hand, each defended for 20 min.

name: Verhalten / Seniorität
tests: Senior behaviour: ownership, conflict, mentoring, reviews, agile thinking
questions: Warum ist ein Scrum Master wichtig?
Wann haben Sie einen Fehler gemacht?
frame: STAR-L: Situation (1 sentence) → Task → Action ('ich', 3 steps) → Result (number) → Lesson
ready: 15 real stories, each under 2 min, with a number and a lesson.

name: Assessment (Bund / Ausschreibung)
tests: Subject knowledge (ZK14), calm and firm (ZK15), clear language at the right level (ZK16), preparation (ZK17)
questions: Erklären Sie das einmal für den Kunden und einmal technisch.
Wie gehen Sie mit einem schwierigen Stakeholder um?
Was wissen Sie über unser Umfeld?
Fallfrage zu einer Technologie aus der Ausschreibung.
frame: Business view first → then technical → check understanding → 2 questions back
ready: Full 45-min mock scored 7/8 or more on the rubric.

name: Abschlussgespräch
tests: Agreement on money, start, workload. Last impression.
questions: Was ist Ihnen wichtig im Vertrag?
frame: Thank → confirm interest → numbers with one reason → ask for the next step
ready: Rate range and walk-away number decided before the call. 2 references ready.
